rv.q: I've seen the role played with more poetic subtlety but never with more energy.

Jamie Lloyd's production is equally thrilling and radical, and is set 50 years hence in a (possibly) post-independence Scotland, brutalised by war and, we may assume from the programme notes, ravaged by the effects of climate change.
This production is a breath of fresh air, a play from the past that is most definitely for the present.

cn.t: Lloyd's high-energy, dystopian Macbeth addresses contemporary politics with urgency. McAvoy delivers a raw, fearless performance that brings visceral conviction to Shakespeare's tragedy in this modern, fast-paced production.
